name: ReaLMistake
description: ReaLMistake is the first error detection benchmark for LLM responses, containing objective, realistic, and diverse errors across four categories: reasoning correctness, instruction-following, context-faithfulness, and parameterized knowledge, annotated by experts on GPT-4 and Llama 2 70B outputs.
reputation: A new expert-annotated benchmark that is still early in adoption, but it fills an important gap for evaluating error detection in LLM outputs.
notes: Highlights challenges in LLM-based error detection and provides a benchmark and code for further research.
